meta.title: How {{brand.name}} works | From the first booking to the next one
meta.description: Your page, bookings and memberships, messages and growth, the room, running the event, guest records, and reports and payouts, in one app for hosts. Use all of it, or start with one part.
meta.socialDescription: One app, from the first booking to the next one. See how {{brand.name}} runs the whole life of an event.

sections.title: One app, from the first booking to the next one.
sections.lead: {{brand.name}} runs the whole life of an event, including the part most tools skip: helping the people in the room actually meet. Use all of it, or start with one part.

items.title: Your page
items.body: Your events, links and reviews on one page, for your bio.

items.title: Bookings and memberships
items.body: Who gets in, what they pay, and members who pay less.

items.title: Messages and growth
items.body: Event messages that send themselves, and links that show what sold.

items.title: The room
items.body: A first hello, groups that mix, and introductions when a guest asks.

items.title: Running the event
items.body: The door, the live console, a dress rehearsal and your team.

items.title: Guest records
items.body: One record per guest, from every booking and every list you bring.

items.title: Reports and payouts
items.body: What worked, what guests said, and your money in your own account.

items.title: Forms, in every step
items.body: Applications, waivers and feedback, with every answer on the guest’s record.
